criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Greetings and Social Pleasantries
categories.definition: User initiates contact, greets the bot, or expresses gratitude without asking for specific information.

categories.name: Virus Definition and General Explanation
categories.definition: User asks for a definition, summary, or general explanation of what COVID-19 is.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: User inquires about symptoms of the virus, checks if specific sensations indicate infection, or asks how to identify the disease in oneself or others.

categories.name: Transmission and Contagion
categories.definition: User asks how the virus spreads, whether specific activities or animals can transmit it, or questions the origin of the virus.

categories.name: Prevention and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: User seeks advice on how to stay safe, prevent infection, or inquire about the efficacy of specific protective measures like masks, gloves, or cleaning products.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: User asks about the existence of a cure, vaccines, or medical treatments and remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics and Data
categories.definition: User requests specific numbers regarding cases, deaths, recovery rates, or other quantitative data related to the pandemic.

categories.name: News and Current Updates
categories.definition: User asks for the latest news, recent developments, press releases, or general updates regarding the pandemic situation.

categories.name: Travel Advice and Restrictions
categories.definition: User inquires about the safety of traveling, specific travel restrictions, or transportation advice related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Animals and Pets
categories.definition: User specifically asks about the risk of COVID-19 regarding pets, wild animals, or transmission between animals and humans.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks to verify the truth of specific claims, asks about debunked myths, or inquires about misinformation regarding the virus.

categories.name: Donations and Charitable Giving
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to donate money, goods, or asks for information on how to contribute to relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing and Forwarding Information
categories.definition: User requests to share the bot, specific reports, or information with friends, family, or on social media.
